early_close_condition: This market will close and expire early if the economic data is released.
rules_primary: If the 12-month percentage change in CPI-U, U.S. city average, all items, not seasonally adjusted, in December 2029 is above 6.0%, then the market resolves to Yes.
rules_secondary: The initially reported value for December 2029 will be used. This market concerns the 12-month percentage change for December 2029, not the annual-average percentage change for the specified year.
title: Will the 12-month percentage change in CPI-U in December 2029 be above 6.0%?
